The right side is `(ℱ.map f ≫ α.app (op Y)) a✝`, which is `α.app (op Y) (ℱ.map f a✝)`. The lemma `appHom_restrict` states exactly that `ℱ'.val.map f (appHom α X x) = α.app (op Y) (ℱ.map f x)`. Therefore, applying `simp` with this lemma will rewrite the left-hand side to the right-hand side, closing the goal.
